start.text: Ah, there you are. You look exhausted. Have you been sleeping at all this semester?

choices.label: Not really… the workload is intense.

fine.text: Your last assignment tells a different story. Office hours are Tuesdays.

honest.text: Honesty! Come to office hours — we can talk about extensions. Mental health matters.

thanks.text: Good. Tuesday, 2pm. Now get some rest.
